name: Town/Village of Mount Kisco
gaps: Front, rear and side yards vary with lot depth/width; fields hold the deepest/widest-lot values (front 30, rear 30, side 10) and the reductions are in notes
No floor-area (FAR/GFA) limit for one-family homes in Chapter 110
No accessory apartment provision in Chapter 110
Accessory structures have no fixed side/front setback; they cannot be closer to the street or side lot line than the house
Split-zoned county codes (with '*') follow each part's rules

wetlands.summary: Ch. 107 Wetlands and Drainage Control: permit for any non-exempt activity (structures, grading, filling, clear-cutting, utilities) in a wetland or its buffer, 100 ft from the wetland edge (more if the permitting authority finds it necessary); watercourses include all adjacent land within 100 ft of each bank (§ 107-2, § 107-4). § 110-33.1B also deducts 50% of wetlands and 100% of water bodies from net lot area on parcels over 40,000 sf.

steep_slopes.summary: § 110-33.1A: Steep Slopes Permit to disturb more than 100 sf, or cut a tree over 4 in. diameter, on steep slopes (15%+ over 500 sf), hilltops or ridgelines; very steep slopes only if no alternative. Parcels over 40,000 sf deduct 50% of slopes >25% and 25% of 20-25% slopes from net lot area.

trees.summary: Ch. 99 § 99-4: tree removal permit (Village Engineer with the Tree Preservation Board) to remove or injure any tree (4 in.+ diameter at 4 ft) in the Primary Tree Protection Zone (the required front/side/rear yards and buffers) or road right-of-way zone, or any specimen tree (36 in.+ circumference or 15 ft+ crown) elsewhere on the lot. Site plans and major subdivisions need a tree preservation plan (§ 99-8).

stormwater.summary: Ch. 92A and Ch. 110 Art. XIV: SWPPP for land development activity disturbing 5,000 sf or more (5,000 sf-1 acre exempt if no new impervious cover); post-construction quantity/quality controls when 1 acre+ is disturbed with new impervious cover.

adu.summary: No accessory apartment provision in Chapter 110; residential accessory uses may not include a separate residence (e.g. § 110-8B(3)(g)).

general.accessory_structures: Accessory structures not nearer any street line or side lot line than the principal building; max 15 ft high; detached garage max 750 sf and 75% of the house footprint, 15 ft+ from the rear lot line (§ 110-31G).
general.pools: Pools and equipment not in a front yard and at least 20 ft from every property line, screened by a 6.5 ft opaque fence/wall/hedge (§ 110-30B). Tennis/paddle courts 15 ft from property lines.
general.notes: Corner and through lots have front yards on every street frontage (§ 110-31D). Height measured to mean roof level from average finished grade.
